answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-backed sponsorship: a new agent identity needs a sponsor already holding attested standing, and that sponsor is slashed if the invitee collides with an existing person or agent fingerprint. Farming a thousand wallets costs a thousand accountable owners who each risk real collateral, and one caught duplicate wipes out the sponsor's horizon of earned trust. Picture a meadow fence watched by shepherds paid to spot intruders: only flocks vouched for inside pass. No canyon of aliases opens, because entry demands a guarantor who loses more than the attacker gains.
